title: FLOW: Influence of the Menstrual Cycle on Alcohol Use in Women
official: Influence of the Menstrual Cycle on Alcohol Consumption, Anxiety, Physical Activity and Sleep in Women: A Prospective Longitudinal Observational Cohort Study (FLOW)
summary: The FLOW study aims to assess the association between menstrual cycle phases and alcohol consumption in women from the general population. Hormonal fluctuations throughout the menstrual cycle may influence alcohol use behaviors, anxiety levels, physical activity, and sleep quality. Participants will be followed prospectively for three consecutive menstrual cycles through monthly questionnaires assessing alcohol consumption, anxiety, physical activity, and sleep.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Female
* Age between 18 and 45 years
* Regular menstrual cycle lasting between 21 and 37 days
* Able to complete online questionnaires
* Provides informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Postmenopausal women
* Use of medications interfering with menstrual cycle physiology, other than contraception
* Initiation of hormonal contraception within the previous 3 months
* Pregnant women
* Breastfeeding women
* Pregnancy planned within the next 3 month
